name: fanout
description: Runs many small one-shot completions or classifications on a cheap model in parallel, as one tool call instead of a subagent per item.

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Register the fanout tools in new sessions. /fanout on|off overrides it for a session.

model.title: Model
model.description: Model for each item, as a full model id.

models.title: Allowed models
models.description: Comma-separated model ids a call may choose. The default model is always allowed.

concurrency.title: Concurrency
concurrency.description: Requests in flight at once across the session (1 to 16).

maxItems.title: Max items per call
maxItems.description: Most items one call may carry (1 to 1000). Above it the call is refused.

maxItemChars.title: Max item characters
maxItemChars.description: Longest item (100 to 100000). Above it the call is refused.

maxTokens.title: Reply cap
maxTokens.description: Reply token cap for complete items (16 to 8192). Classify uses 128, or 256 with reasons.

timeoutSeconds.title: Request timeout (s)
timeoutSeconds.description: Time limit for each request (5 to 600).

inlineResultChars.title: Inline result size
inlineResultChars.description: Largest result returned inline, in characters (1000 to 200000); above it the full results go to a file.

alwaysLoaded.title: Always loaded
alwaysLoaded.description: Put the tools schemas in every request instead of behind ToolSearch.
